title: Telos VSet
excerpt: With decades of experience designing broadcast phone systems, it's no wonder broadcasters agree that Telos Systems makes the industry's most powerful, intuitive and flexible system controllers, known as Telos VSets. The VSet family includes the VSet6, a 6-line phone, and the VSet12, a 12-line model. Both VSet phones can be powered by PoE from a Telos-approved switch, a PoE port on an Axia console engine, or by using the included power injector.
body:
VSet12

The Telos VSet12 phone is beautifully designed, with a friendly LCD color display that uses exclusive Status Symbols to let talent know what’s going on instantly. VSet12 supports up to 12 line appearances; the info-rich display provides caller ID for each line, along with total call time, time ringing-in or on-hold time, and even screener comments from compatible screening software applications.

VSet12 gives talent unprecedented flexibility. You can map groups of lines to a single fader, making it simple to take a queue of calls to air sequentially. One-touch controls let talent step through queued calls, “busy out” incoming lines, lock calls on-air to prevent unintentional disconnection of a VIP. Telos- exclusive “Next Call” key speeds workflow for producers, screeners, and talent. A dump button can be mapped to a GPIO output to control extenral profanity delays. VX and VX Prime systems unlock even further functionality: : You can now spread multiple calls over a number of faders, using one for each call so that operators can control each line’s level individually. You can hard-assign individual lines to fixed faders, such as for VIP calls, Even conference callers together on the fly. A built-in address book and call history log round out VSet12’s features.

VSet6

VSet6 is a six-line phone controller for VX systems. Like the VSet12, it has a bright, attractive LCD color display with Status Symbols that feed talent instant information about line and caller status and controls that enable talent to step through queued calls, busy incoming lines, lock calls on-air, activate the dump button on a profanity delay, and more.

VSet Phone Controls

The LCD displays deliver detailed line status, caller information, caller ID, total time of call, time ringing-in or on-hold, and even comments entered in compatible screening software applications. Shown above are a few of the attractive, instantly understandable Status Symbols that help talent run tight, mistake-free shows.

Each Vset phone has it’s own web server that allows for backing up the configuration, software upgrades and screenshots. Power options include PoE (Power over Ethernet) from an approved Ethernet switch or Telos Alliance xSwitch, or from the included in-line power injector.

Features:

Available in VSet6 6-line or VSet12 12-line models

Can be powered by PoE from Telos-approved switch, PoE port on Axia console, or by using included power injector

Includes LCD color display with status info that feeds talent info on line and caller state

Controls enable talent to step through queued calls, busy lines, lock calls on-air, etc.

Next Call functionality speeds workflows

Compatible with Telos HX6, IQ6, VX Prime and VX
